text: what is the criteria for something to fall into recent
resolution: Inspected the live Asset Explorer history implementation and documented its exact inclusion rules: asset selection, model opening or model-home navigation, world-object selection by underlying asset, and committed face-material assignment all record a recent. Entries are newest-first, deduplicated, capped at 24, omit missing catalog/package records, survive hot reload, and reset on a cold editor restart. No code change was requested or made.
